newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX extends record winning streak.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX extends record winning streak.

text.p: The Austrian ATX index of 21 blue chips continued its winning ways on Wednesday, ending at a record closing high for the eighth day.
The ATX closed eight points, or 0.57 percent, higher at 1,399.4, supported by buoyant international leads. The ATX earlier powered up to an intra-day record high of 1,409.17 points.
* Top ATX gainer Creditanstalt ordinaries, up 34 schillings at 820.
* Leading ATX decliner VA Tech, down 70 schillings at 2,386.
* July ATX future up 10.6 points at 1,408.1
